description:
Autoliv’s mission is to Save More Lives. As part of our Cyber Supply Chain Risk Management team, you will support activities that help protect our global supply chain from cybersecurity risks.

Experience & Competence

  • 1–3 years of experience within cybersecurity, information security, OT security, or IT/OT risk management

  • Ability to perform structured risk assessments across IT and / or OT environments

  • Understanding of NIST CSF, ISO 27005, and IEC 62443

  • Knowledge of supply chain processes and manufacturing environments

  • Familiarity with risk scoring, vulnerability management, and control mapping

  • Understanding of industrial systems and OT networks

  • Experience in international and cross-functional environments

  • Relevant university degree

  • Strong English communication skills

Personality & Leadership

  • Pragmatic and collaborative mindset

  • Analytical and structured approach

  • Self-driven and reliable

  • Strong interpersonal trust-building skills

  • Curious and open-minded

  • Clear communicator

  • Comfortable with ambiguity

  • Aligned with company values

Scope & Responsibilities

  • Execute supplier risk assessments including OT-related suppliers

  • Identify risks across IT and / or OT domains

  • Assess supplier impact on manufacturing and operations

  • Support development of supply chain risk strategy

  • Maintain risk registers and follow mitigation actions

  • Drive improvements in processes including OT risks

Goals of the Role

  • Strengthen OT risk management across suppliers

  • Support development of integrated risk processes

  • Enhance Autoliv’s security posture and resilience by identifying high risk suppliers and pro-actively reducing their risks

*Hybrid work model: 2 days/week on site

We will be more than glad to chat with you about your experience and your career goals.

In our international work setting, you will find a range of opportunities that are designed to enhance your career and personal development. Including new and different perspectives is part of what ensures the team’s success. We are committed to develop people’s skills, knowledge and creative potential. Our training and development programs emphasize technical competency, leadership development and business management skill.

More lives saved – more life lived!
